ns2:course.label: Communication for Planners
ns2:course.description: Covers the graphic and verbal skills required in effectively communicating planning information and ideas: freehand and computer-based graphics, policy argumentation and, integration of verbal and graphic communication. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement and UP 101 or consent of instructor.
